The instant petition has been filed under Articles 226/227 of the Constitution of India for issuance
of a writ in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondents No.1 to 4 to provide police protection
to the petitioner and its employees for the execution/performance of his work as per Food Safety
and Standards Act, 2006 of Government of India read with Food Safety and Standard Rules, 2011.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner contends that the petitioner is a Developer who had set up the colony after taking all necessary statutory approvals alongwith the constructed residential township, the petitioner is also constructed commercial property wherein various multi-national companies are opening their retail outlets including food points.
The private respondent, however, is not allowing the restaurants offering non-vegetarian food to be opened in the said locality.
1 of 2

It is contended that the petitioner had submitted their representation to the Director General of Police, Punjab Police Headquarter, Sector-9, Chandigarh against such illegal hardship being created by private respondents but no action has been taken thereupon.
He contends that as per his knowledge the aforesaid representation has been marked to the office of the Commissioner of Police, Ludhiana.
It is undisputed that the petitioner has not filed any such representation to the Commissioner of Police or to the local Police authority.
Counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the present writ petition with liberty to approach the concerned officials.
